mapper.select: SELECT * FROM coupons ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM coupons WHERE (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW()) AND used_count < usage_limit AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupons (code, type, value, min_order_amount, usage_limit, used_count, status, expires_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{type}, #{value}, COALESCE(#{minOrderAmount}, 0), COALESCE(#{usageLimit}, 0), COALESCE(#{usedCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'), #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE coupons SET code = #{code}, type = #{type}, value = #{value}, min_order_amount = #{minOrderAmount}, usage_limit = #{usageLimit}, used_count = #{usedCount}, status = #{status}, expires_at = #{expiresAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE coupons SET used_count = used_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
